item.title: Over 200 Ukrainian Experts in Middle East to Help Fight Drones, Zelensky Says
item.summary: President Volodymyr Zelensky said that 11 countries in the region have asked for Kyiv’s assistance. Russia has launched such drones against Ukraine for years.

item.title: Israel Intensifies Strikes on Beirut, Escalating Its Campaign Against Hezbollah
item.summary: The Israeli military widened its attacks to the districts in the center of the Lebanese capital, destroying buildings, forcing residents to flee and killing at least 10.

item.title: Netanyahu Hopes Strikes on Iran Will Lead to Uprising and Regime Change
item.summary: Israeli attacks have targeted the command centers of Iran’s repressive, internal security forces in hopes that Iranians will overthrow their rulers. Some see that as wishful thinking.

item.title: Here’s What Happened in the War in the Middle East on Tuesday
item.summary: The deaths of two top Iranian officials were announced on Tuesday, while President Trump once again lashed out at NATO allies who refused to aid the U.S. war effort against Iran.

item.title: Trump’s Next Decision in War: Whether to Retrieve Iran’s Nuclear Fuel
item.summary: A mission to seize or destroy Iran’s nuclear material would be one of the riskiest military operations in modern American history.

item.title: Kharg Island Is an Appealing Target for Trump, With High Risks
item.summary: A U.S. attack or a move to seize control of Iran’s main oil export hub could cripple the country’s ability to profit from its natural resources. But it would also risk sending energy prices even higher.

item.title: Ali Larijani, a Top Iranian Politician and Emissary, Is Dead at 67
item.summary: Killed in an Israeli attack, he was Iran’s leading national security official and a confidant of the former supreme leader. He led a brutal crackdown on protests this year.

item.title: Ali Larijani, Iran’s De Facto Political Leader, Killed by Israel
item.summary: The killing, which Iran confirmed, could embolden Iranian hard-liners, as the U.S.-Israeli bombing campaign continues.

item.title: Israel Keeps Killing Key Iranian Leaders. Will It Work?
item.summary: Israeli officials trumpeted airstrikes that killed Iran’s de facto leader and the commanders of a militia notorious for violently suppressing protests. But “decapitation has its limits,” an analyst warns.

item.title: U.N. Says Attacks on Iran Set to Drive Hunger to Record Levels
item.summary: Tens of millions more people around the world could face acute hunger as the war in the Middle East continues to disrupt shipping and drive up oil prices.
